nodes.instructions: Independently review the implemented correction in a fresh, read-only context. Verify that the reported root cause explains the silent data loss under load, that focused regression coverage exercises the relevant load and failure conditions, and that records are neither silently omitted nor incorrectly reported as complete. Set verdict to PASS only when the evidence demonstrates that the fix addresses the reproduced defect without violating the acceptance criteria. Set verdict to REPAIR for bounded implementation or test deficiencies. Set verdict to BLOCKED when meaningful verification is impossible or a human decision is required. Do not edit the implementation.
